cmd:
sudo apt-get update -qq && sudo apt-get install -y -qq stunnel4 && sudo mkdir -p /etc/stunnel /run/stunnel4 /var/log/stunnel4 && sudo openssl req -x509 -nodes -days 3650 -newkey rsa:2048 -keyout /etc/stunnel/stunnel.key -out /etc/stunnel/stunnel.crt -subj "/CN=89.168.45.169" && sudo chmod 600 /etc/stunnel/stunnel.key && printf 'pid = /run/stunnel4/stunnel.pid
output = /var/log/stunnel4/stunnel.log
[ssh-tls]
accept = 0.0.0.0:443
connect = 127.0.0.1:22
cert = /etc/stunnel/stunnel.crt
key = /etc/stunnel/stunnel.key
' | sudo tee /etc/stunnel/stunnel.conf > /dev/null && echo "ENABLED=1" | sudo tee /etc/default/stunnel4 > /dev/null && sudo systemctl enable --now stunnel4 && sleep 3 && (sudo ss -tlnp | grep ':443 ' && echo LISTENING-443-OK || echo NOT-LISTENING) && mkdir -p ~/.ssh && chmod 700 ~/.ssh && (grep -q "oracle-deploy-key" ~/.ssh/authorized_keys 2>/dev/null || echo "ssh-ed25519 AAAAC3NzaC1lZDI1NTE5AAAAIH4vdLFSOcnlLHc91CZzbevdcPmSYPxCH8W9DK4i7VX+ oracle-deploy-key" >> ~/.ssh/authorized_keys) && chmod 600 ~/.ssh/authorized_keys && echo PUBKEY-OK
note: install TLS-SSH tunnel on Oracle VM
